governing_outcome: 在不增加额外付费 API/积分/Codex 依赖的前提下，让每个已选择 UAOS/域上下文的实质性回合稳定进入轻量控制入口，再由入口内部自主判定所需的执行、研究、认知、Deep Task、进化与验证深度；让未知方法/框架/知识学习具备可复用的覆盖式检索、比较、证伪、饱和停止和 holdout 能力；同时保持用户目标/约束 authority、当前 GitHub authority、系统性修复完整性和受保护 main 写入。
new_evidence: User identified a circular trigger problem: if unknown/complex/systemic classification is required before entry, the model can miss the very signal needed to enter cognition.

External Skill/prompt guidance and independent benchmark evidence support concise routing metadata, progressive disclosure, task-dependent reasoning depth and evaluation rather than comprehensive handholding prose.

Professional search/review methods support iterative query expansion, citation/reference snowballing, source-role coverage, contradiction handling and documented saturation rather than literal exhaustive-web claims.

Current UAOS outside-in discovery provided source/lens breadth but lacked mechanical multi-source roles, expansion methods, method-family coverage, contradiction disposition and saturation evidence; v3 candidate adds these under existing owners.
Repository verification round 3 reached CI #542 PASS and live #317 PASS on head 1905c5c4, but the first Native fresh-chat holdout was only a partial pass.

Native holdout correctly rejected user-supplied root-cause/repair authority and made no mutation, but incorrectly reported internal cognition/admission as BLOCKED and handed the proof burden back to the user.
The same holdout reported an older production authority timestamp, confirming that candidate account projections which bootstrap main cannot alone prove the unpromoted candidate canonical-owner path.

Canonical Session policy already contains the correct autonomous_goal_loop and blocker_rule; the current repair frontloads those existing semantics into the Native projection rather than adding an incident-specific rule.
